whatsNew: Update pop-ups now check for a newly triggered release every 3 seconds while the app is open.
Normal website pages are restored to 80% scale; only the Admin Console stays at 85%.
Pinch-to-zoom remains enabled so users can enlarge text and icons when needed.
Update checks avoid duplicate network requests and duplicate pop-ups.
Forced updates keep the Later/Cancel option hidden.
